_not_included.note: Commodities tested but not added to the live scan universe -- either no validated pair was found, or the global benchmark used was found to be the wrong proxy for the Indian equity side.
_not_included.SB=F_sugar: No FDR-significant correlation found for any candidate against global ICE sugar futures. Trend-continuation was uniformly negative even after market-beta correction, likely because Indian sugar equities are driven by domestic policy (FRP/SAP cane pricing, ethanol mandates, export quotas) rather than the global benchmark. Needs a domestic Indian sugar price series (NCDEX/Agmarknet) to retest properly.
_not_included.ALI=F_aluminium: No candidate cleared FDR significance. One trend-continuation number (NATIONALUM.NS) looked attractive but had no correlation backing and rests on ~13-15 non-independent events -- treated as noise, not a validated signal.
_not_included.TIO=F_iron_ore: No candidate cleared FDR significance. Iron ore/steel is more plausibly driven by China demand and domestic capacity cycles than this specific (thinly-traded) Singapore Exchange contract. Needs a China-demand-linked or domestic steel price series to retest properly.
